en.t: For a long time he could not fall asleep.

units.source_text: 他侧耳倾听着女人的动静，

en.t: He strained his ears, listening for any movement from the woman,

units.source_text: 刚才那般忿忿不平，结果，只不过是对束缚女人的那股势力表示出妒忌，

en.t: and all that indignation just now, in the end, had been nothing more than jealousy toward the force that bound her,

units.source_text: 他还不得不多少抱着些愧疚：

en.t: so he could not help feeling somewhat guilty:

units.source_text: 刚才那番态度简直像催促女人放下手里的活，

en.t: his attitude just now had been almost like urging the woman to put down the work in her hands

units.source_text: 悄悄跟他一起上床似的。

en.t: and quietly get into bed with him.

units.source_text: 事实上，他的情绪激动，看来并非单纯针对女人干的傻事。

en.t: In fact, his agitation did not seem to be aimed simply at the foolish thing the woman had done.

units.source_text: 似乎还有什么不知底细的原因。

en.t: There seemed to be some other cause whose nature he did not understand.
The quilt was growing damper and damper,

units.source_text: 沙子越来越多地黏附到皮肤上来。

en.t: and more and more sand was sticking to his skin.
It was too unfair, too strange.

units.source_text: 所以说，就是丢下铁铲子，

en.t: So even if he threw down the shovel,

units.source_text: 也没有责备自己的必要。

en.t: there was no need to blame himself.

units.source_text: 他没理由承担这份义务。

en.t: He had no reason to shoulder that obligation.

units.source_text: 必须承担的义务已经相当多了。

en.t: the obligations he had to bear were already quite numerous.

units.source_text: 就这样，自己被沙和昆虫吸引而来，

en.t: In this way, drawn here by sand and insects,

units.source_text: 最终似乎只剩下一条路：

en.t: in the end there seemed to be only one path left:

units.source_text: 逃出这种义务的繁重和无所作为……

en.t: to escape from the weight and idleness of this obligation...
